title.en: Your Quick Find icon: one line, the matches on the same page
title.af: Jou Quick Find-ikoon: een reël, die treffers op dieselfde blad
title.zu: Uphawu lwakho lwe-Quick Find: umugqa owodwa, okufanayo ekhasini elifanayo
title.xh: Uphawu lwakho lwe-Quick Find: umgca omnye, iziphumo kwiphepha elinye
title.nso: Seswantšhetšo sa gago sa Quick Find: mothalo o tee, tše di swanago letlakaleng le tee

chapters.nso: Dira seswantšhetšo sa gago sa go akgofa

en: Under your Find results. Your answers are kept as your icon.
af: Onder jou soekresultate. Jou antwoorde word as jou ikoon bewaar.
zu: Ngaphansi kwemiphumela yakho yokuthola. Izimpendulo zakho zigcinwa njengophawu lwakho.
xh: Phantsi kweziphumo zakho zokufumana. Iimpendulo zakho zigcinwa njengophawu lwakho.
nso: Ka fase ga dipoelo tša gago tša go hwetša. Dikarabo tša gago di bolokwa bjalo ka seswantšhetšo sa gago.

en: Tap [[Put it on my home screen]]
Your icon is ready: “Quick Find · Cards”.
af: Tik [[Put it on my home screen]]
Jou ikoon is gereed: “Quick Find · Cards”.
zu: Thepha [[Put it on my home screen]]
xh: Cofa [[Put it on my home screen]]
nso: Kgotla [[Put it on my home screen]]
Seswantšhetšo sa gago se loketše: “Quick Find · Cards”.

en: Open your icon and type one line
For example: MtG, Savannah, Dual land, 4th Edition, under R2300 — then tap [[Find]].
af: Maak jou ikoon oop en tik een reël
Byvoorbeeld: MtG, Savannah, Dual land, 4th Edition, under R2300 — tik dan [[Find]].
zu: Vula uphawu lwakho bese ubhala umugqa owodwa
Isibonelo: MtG, Savannah, Dual land, 4th Edition, under R2300 — bese uthepha [[Find]].
xh: Vula uphawu lwakho uze ubhale umgca omnye
Umzekelo: MtG, Savannah, Dual land, 4th Edition, under R2300 — emva koko ucofe [[Find]].
nso: Bula seswantšhetšo sa gago o ngwale mothalo o tee
Mohlala: MtG, Savannah, Dual land, 4th Edition, under R2300 — ke moka o kgotle [[Find]].

en: The matches show on the same page
Each specific word must be in the listing; “under R2300” is a price limit. Real listings only.
af: Die treffers wys op dieselfde blad
Elke spesifieke woord moet in die advertensie wees; “under R2300” is 'n prysgrens. Net regte advertensies.
zu: Igama ngalinye eliqondile kufanele libe sesikhangisweni; “under R2300” ngumkhawulo wentengo. Izikhangiso zangempela kuphela.
xh: Igama ngalinye elichanekileyo kufuneka libe kwisibhengezo; “under R2300” ngumda wexabiso. Izibhengezo zokwenyani kuphela.
nso: Tše di swanago di bonagala letlakaleng le tee
Lentšu le lengwe le le lengwe le le itšego le swanetše go ba papatšong; “under R2300” ke moedi wa theko. Dipapatšo tša nnete fela.

en: Tap one to ask for an introduction
It opens in TrustSquare. The introduction follows the normal Tuppence rules.
af: Tik een om vir 'n bekendstelling te vra
Dit maak in TrustSquare oop. Die bekendstelling volg die gewone Tuppence-reëls.
zu: Ivuleka ku-TrustSquare. Ukwethulwa kulandela imithetho ejwayelekile ye-Tuppence.
xh: Ivuleka kwi-TrustSquare. Ukwaziswa kulandela imithetho eqhelekileyo ye-Tuppence.
nso: Kgotla e tee go kgopela tsebišo
E bulega go TrustSquare. Tsebišo e latela melao ye e tlwaelegilego ya Tuppence.

en: Untick, or switch it off in My Space
Under your Find results untick [[Make this my quick icon]] — or My Space → My quick icons → [[Switch off]].
af: Ontmerk, of skakel dit af in My Space
Ontmerk [[Make this my quick icon]] onder jou soekresultate — of My Space → My quick icons → [[Switch off]].
zu: Susa umaka, noma uluvale ku-My Space
Ngaphansi kwemiphumela susa umaka ku-[[Make this my quick icon]] — noma My Space → My quick icons → [[Switch off]].
xh: Susa uphawu, okanye uluvale kwi-My Space
Phantsi kweziphumo susa uphawu ku-[[Make this my quick icon]] — okanye My Space → My quick icons → [[Switch off]].
nso: Tloša leswao, goba o se time go My Space
Ka fase ga dipoelo tloša leswao go [[Make this my quick icon]] — goba My Space → My quick icons → [[Switch off]].
